title: Flight deck
subtitle: A small step toward orbit.
brief: Reach the solar console and align the array. Your decisions are recorded below.
objectiveDetail: Find the illuminated console at the back of the cabin.
objectiveDoneDetail: Alignment confirmed. Restart to practice again.
staticPose: Original drawn astronaut · four static directions
sceneLabel: Isometric 3D flight cabin. Move the drawn astronaut with WASD and use the solar console with E.
pausedDetail: Click the room to resume keyboard controls.
error: The flight deck could not start.
errorDetail: WebGL and the local model / astronaut files are required. Try reloading the room.
consoleFallback: Console model unavailable — using the simple training display.
taskDescription: Match the commanded angle to the tracking target, then apply the command.
taskHint: The preview does not change the array until you apply it.
taskErrorDetail: The angle is outside the allowed tolerance. Adjust the slider and try again.
taskSuccessDetail: The solar console confirms the new tracking angle.
prototypeNote: Training slice: this room does not advance the full mission. Movement and task outcomes come from the game core; the character uses static directional artwork.
flight.room.log.arrival: Arrived in the cabin. Solar tracking needs alignment.
flight.room.log.angleRejected: Alignment rejected: {angleDeg}° is outside ±{toleranceDeg}° of the {targetAngleDeg}° target.
